text:
Maya Lin: Quick sync - launching leadflow post + webinar landing tomorrow morning. Need a 5-item SEO ops checklist: canonical choice, 5 internal link owners, redirect fallbacks for promo URLs, JSON-LD for Event+FAQ, and sitemap + SC ping. Can we confirm owners? @Owen @Priya

Owen Park: I'll do the crawl and return top inbound pages in 20m. Will flag any orphan pages.

Priya Patel: I'll prepare Event JSON-LD and a small FAQPage snippet. Will drop to /docs/seo/snippets and link the PR.

Sam Wu: Redirects: we have /promo/midyear and partner variants with ?ref=. Plan: edge strip utm_ and issue 302 in staging, then 301 in prod. I'll open PR for nginx rules.

Ravi Shah: Keyword decision: primary = "inbound lead routing" (use exact in H1). Secondary anchors: "lead routing", "Leadflow integrations".

Maya Lin: Internal links owners (quick): docs/getting-started -> Owen, integrations -> Ravi, partners -> PartnerOps, support -> Support, pricing -> Growth. I'll update the sheet.

Owen Park: Crawl finds one semi-orphaned guide /guides/onboard - recommend linking from /docs/getting-started and the blog.

Priya Patel: JSON-LD example (short block pasted in comments). Also propose BreadcrumbList on blog to help SERP.

Sam Wu: I'll ensure CDN cache keys strip query params so indexed URL is canonical. Will stage test now.

Maya Lin: Priority for deploy: 1) Redirect rules (Sam) 2) JSON-LD in templates (Priya) 3) Internal links (Owen + owners) 4) Sitemap push + Search Console ping (Owen) 5) Postlaunch checks + SERP monitor (Priya). Confirmed?

Everyone: confirmed :thumbsup:

Maya Lin: Thanks team - postlaunch checks at +2h and +24h. Closing thread.
